'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 2 Greg Shaw LS Heading For The Medical Frigate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
